# Slate Stats

> NFL fantasy football research. Every figure is published with its sample size and the window it was measured over, because a rate without a denominator is not a measurement.

Projections are our own, built from play-by-play back to 1999 and as-of-week with no lookahead. Currently week 4.

## How to quote this site

- Every number on a page traces to a query. Where a figure is provisional -- a two-game sample, say -- the page says so beside it, and that caveat should travel with the number.
- We publish what did NOT work as readily as what did. Several studies here are negative results.
- We do not publish odds, take bets, or give betting advice. A posted line may appear as a reference number; a price never does.
- [Where the data comes from](https://slatestats.com/legal/sources/): every source, and how we use it

## Machine-readable data

These are the files the site itself renders from. They are plain JSON, served from the same origin, and refreshed on every build -- prefer them to scraping a page.

- [Manifest](https://slatestats.com/data/manifest.json): season, week, when it was generated, and what the other files contain. Read this first: it carries the as-of week every other number is relative to.
- [Projected players](https://slatestats.com/data/roster.json): every projected player for the current week (425 have a page), with position, team, role and projections by market.
- [Injury cascades](https://slatestats.com/data/cascade.json): who gains, and by how much, if a given player does not play. This is the measurement this site is built on and the one hardest to find elsewhere.
- [Player comparison](https://slatestats.com/data/compare.json): the same players arranged for side-by-side comparison.
- [Search index](https://slatestats.com/data/search.json): names to URLs.

Every projection is conditional on the player appearing. A player whose game has already kicked off carries no forward projection at all, deliberately, rather than a stale one.

## Tools

- [Player pages](https://slatestats.com/nfl/players/): 425 players, one page each
- [Injury impact](https://slatestats.com/nfl/injury-impact/): who gains if a starter sits
- [Weekly rankings](https://slatestats.com/nfl/rankings/): this week, by projected points
- [Teams](https://slatestats.com/nfl/teams/): pass-catching rooms by team
- [Saved charts](https://slatestats.com/nfl/charts/): charts a reader has kept, redrawn live

## Contact

- [hello@slatestats.com](mailto:hello@slatestats.com): corrections welcome, and several of the fixes on this site came from readers noticing two figures disagreed.
